observations: Photo 0 shows a light blue industrial sewing machine on a workbench with a motor below and a control panel with red and green buttons on the right side.
Photo 1 shows the same machine from a top-down angle, with the model number 'EM20U33' clearly visible on the front panel.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of the front of the machine, with the brand 'Emel' and model 'EM20U33' visible on the panel.
The machine has a large handwheel on the right, a foot pedal, and a needle assembly.
The motor is mounted below the machine, with a metal bracket and a wooden pulley attached.
The workbench is light-colored with a speckled pattern, and the background shows a wall with patterned wallpaper and some fabric or cloth on the right.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some minor wear and dirt, especially on the motor and base.
No power cord is visible in any photo, and no accessories (like bobbins, presser feet, or needles) are shown.

claims.evidence: Brand and model 'Emel EM20U33' are clearly visible on the front panel in photo 1 and photo 2.
The machine shows some wear and dirt, especially on the motor and base, but no visible damage is apparent. No proof of functionality is shown.
The machine is on a workbench with a motor and control panel, but no power cord or connection to electricity is visible. The claim of being 'installed' is not verifiable from the photos.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show visible wear, dirt, and minor scratches on the motor and base. The condition appears used, not like new.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
